name: Bingo
summary: Two-player domino trick-taking game adapted from Sixty-Six where blanks count as 7 and first to 7 game points wins.
rules_text: Two players use a double-six set. Shuffle face down, each draws 7 tiles. Turn one boneyard tile face up; its high end is trump. Blank = 7. [0-0] (Bingo) is highest trump regardless. Rank: in each suit double is high, then others descending by other end. Tiles belonging to trump suit are only trumps. Play 14 tricks. In phase one (boneyard not empty) any tile may be played; higher trump wins, otherwise if second player follows the led high number with higher tile they win, else leader wins; Bingo beats everything. Winner collects trick, draws from boneyard first, loser draws, winner leads. When boneyard empty, phase two requires following suit, playing higher trump if possible, and winning if possible. Tile values: trump double 28, other doubles sum of pips, all other trumps sum, [6-4] and [0-3] always 10, rest 0. Last trick bonus 10. First to reach 70 in won tiles may declare win and stop; if correct they score game points, else opponent scores. First to 7 game points wins match.
rating_reason: Domino trick-taking based on Sixty-six, strategic, no spatial board.
